science.title: Partial Cassini VIMS water-ice signature
science.description: Near-2.02 µm water-ice absorption in selected Cassini observations; not ice abundance.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.notes: USGS May 2008 Cassini/Voyager mosaic at 803 m per source pixel (5760 × 2880), resampled into the shared texture layout. No additional detail is created. Coarse polar coverage, source seams and photographed shading remain; gray grid marks explicit no-data. Shared Shadows adds approximate globe lighting. Mean-radius sphere: the real equatorial ridge does not change the silhouette.

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.notes: Published 2014 enhanced-color Cassini composite, photometrically corrected by Paul Schenk, with nominal 400 m source pixels. Colors extend into ultraviolet and infrared. The dark leading hemisphere is real surface albedo, not a shadow or missing imagery. All supplied pixels are preserved; coarse patches and residual photographed shading remain. Shared Shadows and globe lighting remain active; shape is approximated by a sphere.

controls.label: Infrared
controls.notes: Three Cassini VIMS observations from 10 September 2007. False color assigns red to about 2.02 µm, green to 1.59 µm and blue to 1.28 µm. All three channels share a 0–0.45 I/F display range and gamma 2.2; this stretch changes the display only. No photometric correction is applied, so illumination remains. Archive noise filtering and local replacement are retained; original detector defects and potentially affected neighbors are excluded. Gray grid marks unsupported areas and scan gaps.

controls.label: Ice absorption
controls.notes: Near-2.02 µm water-ice band depth relative to a linear 1.82–2.20 µm continuum, using three Cassini VIMS observations from 10 September 2007. This measures absorption strength, not ice abundance. Viewing angle, grain size and noise also affect the values; no photometric correction is applied. Archive noise filtering and local replacement remain; original detector defects and potentially affected neighbors are excluded. Display colors saturate outside 0–0.8; original numerical values are retained. Gray grid marks unsupported areas and scan gaps.
